query:
SELECT 
  ci.id,
  ci.cardName,
  ci.linkedCardId,
  ci.imageUrl AS ci_imageUrl,
  c.imageUrl AS cards_imageUrl,
  c.name AS cards_name
FROM cardInventory ci
LEFT JOIN cards c ON ci.linkedCardId = c.id
ORDER BY ci.buyDate DESC
LIMIT 15;
